_comment: Template for the orchestrator agent. Placeholders: {{NICKNAME}} = project prefix, {{DESCRIPTION}} = one-line description, {{PROMPT}} = full inlined orchestrator prompt text, {{WORKER_NAMES}} = list of worker agent names for crew settings (always includes '{{NICKNAME}}-critic'). NO `resources` key by design: a `file://` resource is ALWAYS loaded into context, so globbing the ledger here would inject all of shared/ — including the unbounded critic_notes.md — into every request (REFERENCE_PATTERN.md §6). The orchestrator reads shared/ with its read/grep/glob tools instead. A knowledgeBase entry plus the `knowledge` tool is added by generate_bundle.py when the spec has one. Filled programmatically by generate_bundle.py — do not hand-edit fields other than by editing generate_bundle.py.
name: {{NICKNAME}}
